scripts.postinstall: cd backend && uv sync --extra dev && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run preview"
